desc_en: Cold lamination film in gloss and matte finishes for protecting printed graphics against scratches, moisture and fading. Roll width, finish and pricing are confirmed per quotation.

detail_en.artwork: For lamination-only supply, tell us the print material, finished size and quantity. For printed-and-laminated work, please provide print-ready artwork; file dimensions and bleed can be checked before production.

highlights: Protects prints from scratches, moisture and fading

detail_en.lead: Cold lamination film is the protective skin for printed graphics: applied by pressure without heat, it keeps photos, posters and prints from scratching, moisture and fading. Gloss and matte finishes; width confirmed per order.
